pageProps.title: Chongchosu Mulhoe Sokcho Main Branch
pageProps.review: Sokcho Chongchosu Mulhoe is a famous mul-hoe restaurant full of fresh seafood. It's a must-visit course for a Sokcho trip where you can enjoy a meal with high turnover and beautiful scenery.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Chongchosu Mul-hoe", "rating": 4 } --- Fresh and plentiful. A bit spicy. ``` ## Review There's a wait because of many customers, but the food comes out very quickly and the store is large, so the turnover rate is good. If you want a place with a good view, you have to wait a little longer. We succeeded! The price is not cheap, but I acknowledge the price because the ingredients are so fresh. A bit spicy. ## Pictures
